entries.title: Psalms 97:1
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Isles - The Gentile nations, as this word, used Isa 42:4 , is expounded, Matt 12:21 .

entries.title: Psalms 97:2
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Darkness - A dark cloud doth encompass him.

entries.title: Psalms 97:6
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Heavens - The angels, yea God himself from heaven.

entries.title: Psalms 97:7
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Confounded - Let them be ashamed of their folly. Gods - All you whom the Gentiles have made the objects of their worship.

entries.title: Psalms 97:8
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Zion - Thy people dwelling in Zion or Jerusalem, to whom Christ came. Heard - The fame of thy judgments, and the setting up the kingdom of the Messiah.

entries.title: Psalms 97:11
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Light - Joy and happiness. Sown - Is laid up for them.
